democracy_data <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2024/2024-11-05/democracy_data.csv')

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(scales)


country_democracy <- democracy_data %>%
  group_by(country_name) %>%
  summarise(
    democracy_percentage = mean(is_democracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

world_democracy <- world %>%
  left_join(
    country_democracy,
    by = c("name" = "country_name")
  )


ggplot(world_democracy) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = democracy_percentage),
          color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#B2182B", "#F4A582", "#FDDBC7",
               "#D1E5F0", "#2166AC"),
    values = rescale(c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Democracy (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Democracy Around the World",
    subtitle = "Percentage of observed years classified as democratic (1950–2020)",
    caption = "Source: TidyTuesday Democracy Data | Grey = No matched data",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey50"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm")
  )
